verdict.rationale: Whether a project-management SaaS publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack only shows a public GitHub repo for the companion MCP server (shortcut-docs-9, shortcut-docs-29) with no license stated. That repo is a separate integration tool, not Shortcut's product source, so it earns no credit. Nothing in the pack shows the core product's source is available under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
